purpose: Integrate the frozen Localization Audit Stage 5 as a Project Doctor selected/executed owning localization validator without changing localization semantics, canonical identity, relation ownership, or historical Doctor v1 contracts.

historicalPreservation.rule: D3/D4 v1 and Promotion V1 remain byte-identical; Stage 6 activates localization only through versioned v2 contracts.

included: Hero/Soldier/Equipment semantic-data changes that can change effective localization inputs
excluded: shared-frontend-only changes without a localization-owned consumer path
Skin/Banner localization expansion not covered by Stage 5

minimumChecks: Regression Coverage Promotion V1 still validates D3/D4 v1 bytes
D2 v2 maps localization tooling without adding nodes/edges
D3 v2 selects exact audit:localization:check command for relevant changes only
D4 v2 allowlists localization-audit and preserves strict npm-run command parsing
Project Doctor closeout uses D4 v2 runner/self-test
D7 v2 validates current PR guard wiring
real pull_request pr-guard executes selected localization-audit
